18996.new_name: Hooded Bunny Sweatshirt and Skirt Set
18996.desc:
A hooded bunny sweatshirt with matching short skirt, in a milk-silk blend, one size for 90-155 lbs. The hood carries the ears and the theme - it is the pajama-category bunny option for cold nights.

The backless cut below the hood keeps it in costume-lingerie territory despite the sweatshirt format. The skirt is short by design, and the colorway follows the pictures.

  • Material: milk-silk blend
  • Includes: hooded sweatshirt, short skirt
  • Style: bunny, hooded, backless
  • Color: as pictured
  • Sizing: one size, 90-155 lbs

One size for 90-155 lbs. The cold-weather bunny set that does not ask anyone to freeze for the costume.
